description: Machine-readable contract manifest for MOCASSIN project, package, results, state, job-folder, event, and MMCFE formats.
notes: Step 06 adds the flat occupationExchanges, dopings, and simulations model sections. The simulation DTO is a flat object with kind, the matching transition array, and a settings object; kind-specific fields are optional in the generated schema because the generator has no oneOf/discriminator support, and the validator rejects a mismatched shape. Nullable simulation settings use the manifest nullable flag. The lattice and simulation sections remain additive under project schema v1; the manifest status/notes and fixtures were updated at that step, and ADR 0009's version-bump rule resumes with the first released format. Step 07 adds the additive reports.validation validation-v1 report; the project schema remains v1 and the report is versioned separately. Step 10 extends the jobTemplates identity stub with collections, configurations, inheritable settings, lattice requests, dopings, selection optimizers, and opaque canonical extension configs; the project schema remains additive v1 and the new populated fixture is registered.

fields.name: model
fields.notes: Authored model sections. Missing sections load as the empty/default model.

fields.name: stableEnvironment
fields.notes: Missing loads the default 1.0 Å cutoff with no filters; the default is omitted on write.

fields.name: clusters
fields.notes: Sorted by id; offsetVectors retain definition order.

fields.name: siteEnergies
fields.notes: Sorted by siteId; entries are sorted by particleId.

fields.name: dopings
fields.notes: Sorted by ascending priority when serialized.

fields.name: simulations
fields.notes: Sorted by id; transition arrays preserve authored order.

itemFields.name: settings
itemFields.notes: Common settings plus only the matching kind-specific fields; the validator rejects a mismatched shape.

itemFields.name: stablePairSets
itemFields.notes: Sparse stable-site pair values; sorted by energyId and particle key.

itemFields.name: unstablePairSets
itemFields.notes: Sparse unstable-site pair values; sorted by energyId and particle key.

itemFields.name: groupSets
itemFields.notes: Sparse values; sorted by clusterEnergyId and occupation tuple.

itemFields.name: siteEnergyOverrides
itemFields.notes: Sparse overrides of the authored site-energy background; sorted by siteId and particleId.

itemFields.name: transitionRuleSets
itemFields.notes: Kinetic rule frequencies; sorted by transitionKind, transitionId, and ruleGeometryId.

fields.name: objectStyles
fields.notes: Optional; defaults to an empty array.

fields.name: run.mcs
fields.notes: Relative path to the final state.

fields.name: prerun.mcs
fields.notes: Relative path to the KMC pre-run state.

model.notes: Final Step 08 compiled-model projection: domain-separated canonical projection over provenance, particles, structure/P1, pair/cluster geometry and table shapes, transition rules/encoding, and simulation encodings. Runtime settings and energy/frequency values are excluded.

parameterization.notes: Final Step 09 parameterization projection: domain-separated six-field MessagePack array over the compiled-model signature and the dense applied values. Stable IDs, template metadata, set headers, sparse/unset markers, diagnostics, summaries, timings, and all runtime settings are excluded. Floats are float64 quantized to 12 decimals with round half away from zero; negative zero is normalized.

lattice.notes: Section-level projection established in Step 00; field-level signed types are finalized in Step 11.

signatureVectors.notes: Step 08 adds the compiled-model vector. Step 09 and Step 11 add their vectors.
